sop_thesis: **Cronos Group Common Share (CRON)** operates in Health Care ( Medicinal Chemicals and Botanical Products ) with an established market capitalization of $1.26B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Patented Molecular Entities, Clinical Trial Data & Regulatory Exclusivity. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $3.78 (18.1% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $3.14 (Tranche 1), $2.94 (Tranche 2), and $2.72 (Tranche 3).
